holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank received a GST show cause notice on September 30, 2026 for ₹229.14 crore plus interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as MD and CEO of ICICI Life effective October 13, 2026, with Sidharatha Mishra appointed from October 14, 2026.
For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue stood at ₹52,241 crore and net profit reached ₹16,276 crore.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth for the bank in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 6.13%. A 3-month return of -3.30% weighed marginally on portfolio performance, while its 29.3% sector overlap with Financials makes its earnings crucial for fund returns.

watch.text: Watch the leadership transition at ICICI Life as Sidharatha Mishra assumes charge on October 14, 2026.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank appointed Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO for three years starting October 27, 2026.
The bank reported provisional September 2026 advances of ₹33,075 billion and deposits of ₹33,275 billion.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake by 2.4% during the September quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.69% weight, HDFC Bank's -14.27% 3-month return created the largest individual drag on the portfolio, subtracting 0.812% from total returns.

watch.text: Watch the formal onboarding of incoming MD and CEO Anup Bagchi on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance allotted ₹13,008.6 crore in unsecured NCDs at a 7.90% coupon maturing in October 2036.
Rating agencies CARE and CRISIL assigned AAA/Stable ratings to ₹67,000 crore of debentures.
A customs order levied a penalty and fine of ₹18,74,978, which the company decided to appeal.

expected.text: Reports project European diesel shortages could lift Q2 O2C earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.42% weight, Reliance Industries detracted 0.570% from the fund over 3 months following a -10.51% price return.

watch.text: Watch developments around the proposed Jio Platforms listing and price discovery.

holdings.name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd

what_changed.text: Company management scheduled an in-person meeting with Macquarie India on September 22, 2026.

expected.text: Jefferies projected a 52% upside for the stock.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.70% weight, Hitachi Energy detracted 0.288% over 3 months as the stock pulled back -6.13%, despite an annual gain of 72.61%.

watch.text: Watch order inflows across high-voltage transmission and power grid infrastructure.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T PT&D secured multiple mega EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and India.
L&T Energy CarbonLite received an LNTP for the 2x800 MW Chandrapura thermal power project.
The company extended the timeline to complete its stake disposal in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 4.32% of the fund and lowered 3-month performance by 0.266% amid a -6.15% return, reflecting Industrials sector headwinds.

watch.text: Watch for the conclusion of the stake disposal in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad by December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd

what_changed.text: Airtel rolled out new postpaid tariff plans featuring free annual international roaming.
Airtel Business introduced IQ Gateway, an enterprise communications suite compliant with DPDP rules.
The Department of Telecommunications levied penalties totaling ₹8.63 lakh for verification norm lapses.

holdings.why_it_matters: Bharti Airtel carries a 3.91% weight in the fund and dropped 6.00% over the last 3 months, offsetting gains in other tech holdings.

watch.text: Watch customer adoption of the revised postpaid tariff tiers launched on October 8, 2026.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Zomato recorded ₹20,211 crore in revenue and ₹92 crore in net profit for the June 2026 quarter.
Management reported onboarding 3.1 lakh delivery partners across Zomato and Blinkit during FY26.
The company secured an ESG score of 76.00, placing it in the Leader band for FY2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.15% portfolio weight, Zomato added 0.368% to fund returns through an 11.67% 3-month gain.

watch.text: Watch regulatory implications after the CBIC clarified a 5% GST rate applies across platform models.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: The RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD and CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank for three years from January 1, 2027.
Provisional Q2 net advances came in at ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits reached ₹6,51,491 crore.
The bank approved a merger scheme between subsidiaries KMIL and KAAML at a 7:6 share swap ratio.

expected.text: Nomura forecasted 17% core PPOP growth for the bank in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.04% fund weight, Kotak Bank gained 16.79% over 3 months, generating a +0.510% return contribution that helped soften weakness in other lenders.

watch.text: Watch the Board meeting scheduled for October 24, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: State Bank of India acquired nearly 40% of Reliance Industries' $1.35 billion debt offering.
The bank conducted institutional investor interactions on September 25, 2026.
For the quarter ended June 2026, net profit was reported at ₹25,121 crore on revenue of ₹136,240 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: SBI accounts for 3.01% of the fund; its -7.42% 3-month decline added to the overall drag within the portfolio's 29.3% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Watch progress on the bank's initiative to consolidate its primary dealership stake.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Divi's reported June 2026 revenue of ₹3,080 crore, net profit of ₹902 crore, and an operating margin of 41%.
Shareholders approved all resolutions at the AGM on August 10, 2026, including a ₹30 per share dividend.

expected.text: Citi reaffirmed a Buy rating with a target price of ₹11,700 based on oral Wegovy potential.

holdings.why_it_matters: Despite a modest 2.78% fund weight, Divi's was the portfolio's top 3-month performer (+36.63%), contributing a standout +1.018% to fund returns.

watch.text: Watch index review announcements ahead of the March 2027 NSE rebalancing.

portfolio.statement: Baroda BNP Paribas Large Cap Fund holds 97.9% in equities across large-cap leaders, with the top 10 positions comprising 42.1% of assets.
interp: Financials dominate at 29.3%, followed by Industrials at 14.6% and Technology at 14.5%, creating significant sensitivity to banking and capital goods cycles.
Portfolio returns over 3 months (-3.97%) were weighed down by drops in HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries despite a strong positive offset from Divi's Laboratories.
portfolio.line: A large-cap portfolio weighted towards private banks and industrial infrastructure navigating corporate leadership transitions and project execution.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories gained 36.63% over 3 months, delivering +1.018% in estimated portfolio contribution.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 16.79% over 3 months, providing a +0.510% contribution boost supported by strong provisional credit data and CEO clarity.
HDFC Bank dropped 14.27% over 3 months, generating the largest negative contribution of -0.812% following foreign investor selling.
Reliance Industries dropped 10.51% over 3 months, creating a -0.570% contribution drag on the fund.

themes.title: Leadership Transitions in Banking
themes.text: Top private sector banks in the portfolio are undergoing structural top-management shifts that drive investor focus on continuity.

themes.title: Industrial Order Backlog Expansion
themes.text: Heavy engineering and power equipment holdings continue to secure domestic and international infrastructure contracts.

macro.why: With 29.3% in Financials, fund returns depend heavily on deposit mobilization and loan advance trends.
Earnings and cash flows at conglomerate energy holdings are directly sensitive to global diesel margins and refining spreads.

priced_in.text: Solid balance sheet strength and top-tier credit ratings supporting ongoing long-term debt issuance.
Routine regulatory oversight, including telecom compliance fines and tax show cause notices.

could_change.title: Postpaid Tariff Monetization
could_change.text: Whether newly adjusted postpaid plans and international roaming features translate into expanded ARPU.

could_change.title: Asset Monetization Timelines
could_change.text: Timely execution of non-core asset sales like metro concession stakes to free up capital.

portfolio.risk_note: A heavy 29.3% concentration in Financials makes the fund highly vulnerable to banking sector weakness, as evidenced by HDFC Bank subtracting 0.812% over the last 3 months.
